title: The Cartographer's Lantern
statement: They say a mapmaker once tried to chart every star in the heavens, and grew old before the sky was half-finished — so the stars, moved by her stubborn devotion, gathered themselves into a lantern and hung it above the unfinished corner of her map, lighting the way for whoever dares to continue. Sailors call it the Patience Light: it appears dimmest to those in a hurry, and burns brightest for anyone still willing to get delightfully lost.
